hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the symbolic template polygamma(n, z) at n=0 and n=1.
required_assumptions: z is in the domain of polygamma(0, z) and polygamma(1, z)
hypotheses.rationale: Both summands are evaluations of the same parameterized polygamma function at consecutive integer orders.

hypotheses.construction_plan: Apply the derivative operator d/dtheta to log_gamma(theta) the number of times given by 'order', then set theta=z. For polygamma(0,z) use one derivative; for polygamma(1,z) use two derivatives.
required_assumptions: log_gamma(theta) is sufficiently differentiable at theta=z
hypotheses.rationale: Polygamma functions are successive derivatives of log gamma, so the two terms share a single derivative-family master function.
